name: facebookresearch_mask2former/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_mask2former/predict.py.run_Predictor_predict: run the Predictor class to perform panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation on an input image
facebookresearch_mask2former/predict.py.create_Predictor_setup: create a Mask2Former predictor with COCO panoptic segmentation model weights and all segmentation modes enabled
facebookresearch_mask2former/predict.py.build_Predictor_class: build a cog Predictor class that loads a Mask2Former Swin-Large model for image segmentation inference
facebookresearch_mask2former/predict.py.review_Predictor_predict: review the Predictor predict method that concatenates panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation results into a single output image
facebookresearch_mask2former/predict.py.refactor_Predictor_visualizer: refactor the Predictor to reuse a single Visualizer instance instead of creating three separate ones for each segmentation type

facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net.p.run_mask2former_training: run the MaskFormer training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net.p.run_mask2former_evaluation: run evaluation only on a MaskFormer model using a config file and pre-trained weights
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net.p.build_trainer_optimizer: build an optimizer for the MaskFormer model with configurable SGD or AdamW and gradient clipping
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net.p.build_trainer_evaluator: build an evaluator for datasets like COCO, ADE20K, Cityscapes, or Mapillary Vistas for segmentation tasks
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net.p.build_trainer_train_loader: build a training data loader with dataset mappers for semantic, panoptic, or instance segmentation

facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net_v.run_trainer_train: run the MaskFormer video training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net_v.run_trainer_eval: run the MaskFormer video model evaluation only mode using a config file and pre-trained weights
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net_v.build_trainer_optimizer: build an AdamW or SGD optimizer with gradient clipping and per-layer learning rate for the model
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net_v.build_trainer_train_loader: build a YTVIS training data loader with dataset mapper and detection dataset dicts
facebookresearch_mask2former/train_net_v.test_trainer_model: test the MaskFormer video model on a dataset and print evaluation results in CSV format
